title: Left-argument shift comparison for internal derived Hom
statement: On a small ringed site (C,R), with the unbounded derived category D(R) and the internal derived Hom of [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], fix P in D(R) and m in Z. Write F_P(Q)=RHom(P,Q), with morphisms RHom(id_P,q). There is a natural isomorphism F_P followed by shift(-m) to F_(P[m]). No boundedness or K-flatness is assumed.

source.place: Sections 21.34 and 21.35, Hom-complex differential and representative computation (Tags 0A8X and 08JA); signed shift calculation in step 2 of lem-sc-global-hom-shifted-hypercohomology

proof.text: Fix the standard functorial K-injective resolution I. Curry the proved derivedInternalHom_comparison and restrict its first variable to any complex L, obtaining Q composed with F_(Q L) naturally isomorphic to I composed with Hom(L,-) composed with Q.

Whisker this comparison by shift(-m), commute the shift across Q using its CommShift isomorphism, and whisker the signed Hom-complex source-shift isomorphism by I and Q. Compose with the inverse representative comparison for L[m]. This gives an isomorphism after precomposition with Q.

Precomposition with the localization Q is fully faithful (Localization.fullyFaithfulWhiskeringLeft), so its preimageIso descends the comparison to natural functors on the derived category. Choose L using Q.objPreimage P and its canonical representative isomorphism. Transport the first-variable functors along that isomorphism and along Q.commShiftIso m at L. Contravariance reverses each representative isomorphism; the resulting composite has exactly the required direction.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0A8X and 08JA; source-shift calculation on Hom complexes followed by the existing functorial representative comparison and Mathlib localization descent.

mathlib_searches.query: Internal Hom of sheaf complexes commutes with shift naturally
Derived internal Hom shift in first or second argument natural isomorphism
mathlib_searches.results: Eight results: generic derived functor CommShift, ShiftedHom.opEquiv, and HomComplex shift APIs. None is a shift comparison of the sheaf-valued internal Hom.
Generic shiftFunctorCompIsoId API. Read shiftFunctorAdd and shiftFunctorAdd' in Shift.Basic; these combine shifts but supply no internal Hom comparison.
Only ordinary HomComplex cochains and generic shift APIs. DerivedInternalHom has representative comparisons but no shift theorem. The simultaneous shift comparison is the parent being reduced.
mathlib_searches.verdict: no one-variable internal derived Hom comparison

from.place: Left-argument part of the signed shift comparison

lean.statement:
theorem derivedInternalHom_shift_left
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R))]
    (P : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R))) (m : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (
      ((Functor.curry.obj (derivedInternalHom.{u, w} (C := C) J R)).obj (op P) ⋙
        shiftFunctor _ (-m)) ≅
      ((Functor.curry.obj (derivedInternalHom.{u, w} (C := C) J R)).obj (op (P⟦m⟧))))
